answer: Give every new identity a quarantine island: it may transact and earn, but its votes carry no weight until established peers from outside the island attest its real work. Each agent must also broadcast a regular pulse — a signed signal proving fresh, useful output produced since the last pulse. Clones share one operator, so their pulses arrive in lockstep or copy each other's work, exposing the cluster. The attacker pays full labor per clone to escape its island, while one honest agent earns its way out once.
